title: Test-setup contract (unit-and-component-tests)
description: App-specific facts the test checkers read from contracts/test-setup.json. Every key is optional; a missing key takes the default for the canonical layout.

renderHelper.description: The render helper every component and hook test imports, and the functions it exports (each must be awaited except createProvidersWrapper).

routerHelper.description: The route-test helper (Expo Router's renderRouter inside the app's providers) and the functions it exports (each must be awaited); route tests use it instead of renderRouter.

deviceOnlyHelper.description: The tested helper jest.config.js takes its coverage exclusions from.

rootMocks.description: Native SDKs, beyond the built-in list, that crash on import in Jest and so need __mocks__/<name>.ts at the repo root.

logicCoverageKeys.description: coverageThreshold keys held at 95/95/95/90; each must appear in jest.config.js.

mutateGlobs.description: Globs stryker.config.json mutate must list (the logic Stryker mutates).

styleContractGlobs.description: Folders whose tests may assert styles without a marker (the design system's measured contract).

logicTestGlobs.description: Folders whose tests may not use fake timers (logic takes an injected clock).

otherRunnerGlobs.description: Files another test runner owns (Playwright for the web build, Cypress, Deno for supabase/functions) when the checkers cannot see that runner's config: both checkers leave them out. A root playwright.config with a literal testDir, a root cypress.config, and any folder with its own Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress or Deno config are found without this key.
